## lockstep plan check runs company planning s validator

ID: `lockstep-plan-check/lockstep-plan-check-runs-company-planning-s-validator`

Status: **implemented and tested**

`lockstep plan check` SHALL accept `--repo PATH` (default the current directory) and `--json`. It SHALL run Company Planning's `validate_planning_package.py` on `docs/planning/planning-package.json` under the repository, fetched from origin/main of Company Planning and run by the same function and interpreter choice `ship` uses (so `SHIP_PLANNING_VALIDATOR`, `SHIP_COMPANY_PLANNING` and `SHIP_VALIDATOR_PYTHON` work the same), print the validator's output, and exit with the validator's exit status, except that, as in `ship`, a package that fails only the freshness check (it passes with `--no-freshness`) exits 0 with a warning. When `docs/planning/work-units.json` exists it SHALL also report the work-unit problems and exit 1 when there are any. It SHALL exit 2, saying why, when the repository has no planning package or the validator cannot be fetched or run, or exits with a status other than 0 or 1. With `--json` it SHALL print one object with `ok`, the validator's exit status and output, and the work-unit problems. Lockstep SHALL hold no copy of the validator's checks.

## the validator s source is set in lockstep yaml

ID: `lockstep-plan-check/the-validator-s-source-is-set-in-lockstep-yaml`

Status: **implemented and tested**

`ship` and `lockstep plan check` SHALL take Company Planning's validator from the first of: `SHIP_PLANNING_VALIDATOR` (a file, used as given); `SHIP_COMPANY_PLANNING` (a local Company Planning checkout, read at `origin/<ref>`); `planning.validator.repo` in `lockstep.yaml` on the repository's default branch at `origin` (an address git can clone, kept as a bare clone under `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/lockstep/`, default `~/.cache/lockstep/`, in a folder named by a hash of the address, cloned or fetched under a file lock with `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0`, ssh `BatchMode=yes` and a 300-second timeout, and read at `<ref>`); else `~/code2/company-planning` read at `origin/<ref>`. `planning.validator.ref` SHALL name a branch, `main` when absent. Each run SHALL print and log the line `ship: planning validator: <source>` naming the source that won and why, and SHALL print and log a warning when an environment variable overrides a configured repository. A `planning.validator` that is not a mapping of a text `repo` and an optional text `ref` SHALL refuse with a configuration error naming the setting. A clone or fetch that fails or times out SHALL be reported as the validator not fetchable, naming the address. Credentials SHALL come only from the user's own git setup, never from `lockstep.yaml`.

## work units form a checked dag

ID: `lockstep-plan-check/work-units-form-a-checked-dag`

Status: **implemented and tested**

`lockstep plan units` SHALL read `docs/planning/work-units.json` (record type `work_units`, a list `units`) and exit 1, naming each problem, unless: each unit has a unique `id`, a `title`, a `depends_on` list of existing unit ids (empty means it can start now), a `touches` list of repository paths, and a `status` of `planned`, `in progress` or `merged`; a `merged` unit has `evidence`; and the dependencies contain no cycle. It SHALL print the units that are ready (not merged, every dependency merged), the longest chain of unmerged units, and each pair of unmerged units with no dependency path between them whose `touches` overlap (paths are compared as exact strings, so a directory and a file inside it do not overlap). It exits 2 when the file is missing or not JSON. `lockstep plan check` SHALL report the same problems when the file is present.
